title: Advantage or dependency?
instruction: Your website runs on hosting in the cloud. Which of these is an advantage, and which is a dependency on someone else’s company?

items.text: The website runs even when you turn your computer off
items.why: The server is on non-stop; you don’t need your computer for it.

items.text: It handles a thousand visitors at once
items.why: A data centre has power you don’t have at home.

items.text: When the company shuts the service down, the website disappears
items.why: The website lives with them. That is why you keep a backup elsewhere.

items.text: Data from sign-up forms is stored in the country where the data centre stands
items.why: The local laws apply to it, not necessarily ours.

items.text: The company takes care of updating the server
items.why: You don’t have to deal with patches and maintenance yourself.

items.text: The company can block your account
items.why: You follow its terms. If you break them, or if they change, the website is gone.

items.text: A friend can open the website from anywhere in the world
items.why: The server is connected to the internet and answers everyone.

debrief: The cloud gives you a server that never sleeps. In return you depend on a company, so keep the files of your website somewhere else too.
